# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

Laravel 13 monolith, service-layered (thin controllers/jobs → `app/Services` + `app/Tools`), serving a Vue 3 SPA/PWA over `api/v1`, a Filament 5 admin at `/admin`, and Reverb WebSocket push; async work on Redis queues.

### Directory layout

```
app/
  Ai/Agents/            # laravel/ai agents: IntentClassifier, MemoryHypothesisExtractor, RuntimeAgent
  Ai/StructuredResultSchema.php
  Console/Commands/     # jarvis:* (approvals expire, retention prune, connector health-check, tool sync, audit report)
  Events/               # broadcast events: Agent, Approval, Assistant, Connector, Conversation, Task, Tool, NotificationCreated
  Exceptions/           # domain exceptions
  Filament/             # admin: 14 Resources, Pages (SettingsPage, UsageDashboard), Widgets, Actions
  Http/Controllers/Api/V1/  # JSON API controllers (base Controller is empty)
  Http/Requests/Api/V1/     # FormRequests per write endpoint
  Http/Resources/       # 16 API resources
  Http/Middleware/      # EnsureUserIsActive (active), EnsureUserIsAdmin, SecurityHeaders
  Jobs/                 # ProcessUserMessage, RunTask, ExtractMemoryHypotheses, GenerateConversationTitle, SyncMcpServerTools
  Jobs/Middleware/      # WithLogContext
  Listeners/            # ExecuteApprovedTool, PublishDeniedApproval
  Models/               # entities + 15 lookup models (LookupModel base)
  Policies/             # owner policies (Concerns/AuthorizesOwner)
  Results/              # ResultNormalizer, ResultValidator, Payloads/*
  Services/             # routing, brain, agents, memory, tasks, approvals, connectors, usage
  Support/              # AuditLogger, Settings, UntrustedContent, McpUrlValidator, JsonSchemaValidator, HealthCheck, ToolName
  Tools/                # ToolExecutor, ToolAdapter, AgentTool, Http/Mcp handlers, Internal/*, InternalToolRegistry
bootstrap/app.php       # statefulApi, /up outside web group, 429 rendering, JSON errors for api/*
database/               # 30 migrations, factories, seeders (lookups, settings, admin, agents)
resources/js/           # SPA: pages, layouts (HUD), components/{hud,results,ui}, stores (Pinia, 1 per domain), lib (fetch http, echo), router, i18n
resources/schemas/results/  # JSON schemas for structured result types
routes/                 # api.php, web.php (SPA shell + fallback), channels.php, console.php (schedule), ai.php (commented example)
public/sw.js            # PWA service worker (vite-plugin-pwa)
tests/                  # Feature, Unit, js (Vitest), Concerns
compose.yaml            # Sail: laravel.test, pgsql, redis, reverb, queue, scheduler, mailpit, rustfs
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
|---|---|---|
| HTTP API (`Http/Controllers/Api/V1`, Requests, Resources) | Validation, `Gate::authorize()` ownership, 202/402/409 mapping, resource shaping | AI calls, tool runs, state transitions (delegated to services/jobs) |
| Policies (`app/Policies`, `AuthorizesOwner`) | Per-user ownership checks (`user_id`) | Admin gating (`Gate::define('admin')` in `AppServiceProvider`) |
| Jobs (`app/Jobs`) | Queue boundaries; chat orchestration in `ProcessUserMessage`; task runs in `RunTask` | Business rules (call services) |
| AI Brain (`IntentRouter`, `MessageRouter`, `ModelSelector`, `FallbackChain`, `BrainClient`, `CostLimitGuard`, `UsageRecorder`, `ContextBuilder`) | Intent classification, model choice, streaming with fallback, usage rows, cost cap | Tool execution, persistence of tasks |
| Agent Engine (`AgentRuntimeFactory`, `AgentRunner`, `DelegationService`, `Ai/Agents/RuntimeAgent`) | Building `RuntimeAgent` (instructions + untrusted-data policy + authorized tools), `agent_executions`, tool-call limit, timeout, delegation guards | Tool authorization/validation (in `ToolExecutor`) |
| Tool Engine (`app/Tools`) | Authorization, JSON Schema in/out, approval gating, timeout via `pcntl_alarm`, `tool_executions`, `tool.*` events, `tool_executed` audit | Approval decisions (in `ApprovalService`) |
| Tasks (`TaskService`, `RunTask`, `TaskContext`, `Tools/Internal/*Task*`) | Task state machine, steps/logs/progress, cooperative cancel, retry | Creating tasks from chat (`createFromMessage` has no caller) |
| Approvals (`ApprovalService`, listeners) | Request/approve/deny/expire, task resume, notifications | Running the tool (listener `ExecuteApprovedTool` → `ToolExecutor`) |
| Memory (`MemoryService`, `MemoryRetriever`, `EmbeddingService`, `SensitiveDataDetector`, `MemoryContextSource`) | Remember/dedupe/confirm, pgvector retrieval, sensitive block | Hypothesis scheduling (job `ExtractMemoryHypotheses`) |
| Connectors (`ConnectorService`, `ConnectorStatusService`, `McpClient`, `McpUrlValidator`) | MCP lifecycle, discovery, health status, URL validation | Tool execution (`McpToolHandler`) |
| Results (`app/Results`, `StructuredResultExtractor`) | Typed payload extraction + schema validation, text fallback | Rendering (SPA `components/results`) |
| Support (`app/Support`) | Cross-cutting: audit, runtime `Settings`, `UntrustedContent`, provider-safe `ToolName`, health | Domain decisions |
| Admin (`app/Filament`) | Back-office CRUD, settings page (`Settings::RANGES`), usage dashboard (`UsageReport`) | End-user flows |
| SPA (`resources/js`) | HUD UI, Pinia stores, Echo listeners, PWA shell | Authorization (server-side only) |

### Runtime processes

| Process | Command | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Web | `public/index.php` (SPA shell, `/api/v1`, `/admin`, `/up`) | `compose.yaml` `laravel.test` |
| Queue worker | `queue:work redis --queue=tasks,default,low --tries=3 --timeout=960 --max-jobs=500 --max-time=3600` | `compose.yaml` `queue` |
| WebSocket | `reverb:start --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8080` | `compose.yaml` `reverb` |
| Scheduler | `schedule:work` → `jarvis:approvals:expire` (1 min), `jarvis:connectors:health-check` (1 min, no overlap), `jarvis:retention:prune` (daily) | `routes/console.php` |

### External integration points

| System | Client/config | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| AI providers | `laravel/ai`; `ProviderRegistry` registers `ai_providers` rows at runtime; `config/ai.php` | Keys encrypted in DB; `*_API_KEY` env fallback; tool names sanitized by `ToolName::forProvider` (`^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$`) |
| MCP servers | `McpClient` over `Laravel\Mcp\Client::web()` | HTTP(S) only; `McpUrlValidator` blocks private hosts unless `MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS` |
| REST/webhook tools | `HttpToolHandler` (`Http::acceptJson()->timeout()`) | Output wrapped by `UntrustedContent` |
| PostgreSQL + pgvector | `config/database.php` | HNSW index `memory_embeddings_embedding_hnsw` (`vector_cosine_ops`) |
| Redis | `config/queue.php`, `config/cache.php` | Queue, cache, session, limiters, cancel flags |
| Reverb | `config/reverb.php`, `config/broadcasting.php`; SPA `resources/js/lib/echo.ts` | Private channel `user.{id}` (`routes/channels.php`) |

### Macro flow: chat message

```
SPA POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages
  |
  v
ConversationMessageController::store
  CostLimitGuard (402) -> save user msg -> broadcast conversation.message.created
  |  ProcessUserMessage::dispatch()->onConnection('redis')      => 202
  v
[queue default] ProcessUserMessage
  pending assistant msg -> assistant.state.changed THINKING
  |
  v
MessageRouter (IntentRouter) -> messages.meta.routing
  |                                   |
  | direct_answer                     | use_tool / delegate_agent / long_task
  v                                   v
ContextBuilder + BrainClient::stream  AgentRunner::run (sync, same job)
  FallbackChain, UsageRecorder          RuntimeAgent (maxSteps = toolCallLimit + 2)
  |                                     ToolAdapter -> ToolExecutor
  |                                     AgentTool delegate.<slug> -> DelegationService
  +---------------+-------------------+
                  v
  assistant.response.chunk ... -> StructuredResultExtractor
  -> assistant.response.completed + state IDLE
  -> ExtractMemoryHypotheses [queue low]
  -> GenerateConversationTitle [queue default] (provisional title)
```

### Macro flow: approval-gated tool

```
ToolExecutor (is_write || is_sensitive, no approval)
  -> ApprovalService::request
       approval pending, expires_at; task -> waiting_approval
       notification approval_pending; chat payload.type = approval_request
  -> ToolResult::pendingApproval (tool NOT run)

SPA POST /approvals/{id}/approve|deny   or   scheduler jarvis:approvals:expire
  -> ApprovalService -> audit + ApprovalDecided event
       |-- approved -> ExecuteApprovedTool -> ToolExecutor (runs once, approval_id)
       |-- denied   -> PublishDeniedApproval
       '-- task waiting_approval -> running -> RunTask(resumeFromStep) [queue tasks]
```

### Macro flow: task run

```
TaskService::queue (callers: retry(); createFromMessage has no caller in app/)
  pending -> queued -> RunTask::dispatch()->onQueue('tasks')
  |
  v
[queue tasks] RunTask
  markRunning -> AgentRunner with TaskContext
  internal tools StartTaskStep / FinishTaskStep / SetTaskProgress / TaskLog
  cancel flag task:{id}:cancel_requested checked before each step
  |
  +-- completed -> task_completed notification
  +-- failed / timeout -> RunTask::failed -> task_failed notification
  each transition -> task.updated (progress throttled 500 ms)
```

### Macro flow: connector health

```
scheduler (every minute) -> jarvis:connectors:health-check
  -> due connectors (connector.health_check_minutes, default 5)
  -> McpClient ping -> ConnectorStatusService
       status change -> connector.status.changed; error -> connector_error notification
POST /connectors/{id}/resync -> ConnectorService -> SyncMcpServerTools [queue default] -> mcp_tool_definitions
```
